text: The X4 harness runs in SIT against contract stubs from Day 1, with the environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic case, deviation and referral keys, the Aric referral answer shape and status vocabulary, the investigation tracking evidence, the evidence format and retention, and the pass or fail gate held as harness configuration agreed at the wave 4 entry check.
why: The source documents do not specify them and the story must not wait for a decision; none of them is a business value, so they are held as configuration and a stub pass is reported as a stub pass.
read: WP B-ITG-W4-06; Template and Rules §R7.2 s13 and §R9; legacy RWB-E7-004; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 INT-31 line 240
confirm: Integration lead at the wave 4 entry check
impact: A change to the configuration changes the fixture and the report only, never a rule; the referral is asserted against the fixture until RWB-S8-E7004-APP and the Aric integration land.
